scope: Reauthorize stored managed jobs before explicit resume and every new provider dispatch.

finding.status: confirmed by source trace and actual disposable regression
finding.boundary: Owner-controlled toolkit capabilities on previously authorized stored jobs.
excludedClaims: No anonymous access, OS elevation, repository-root escape or global pause/read-only bypass established.
No production remediation or active-job cancellation claimed.

decisions: Use one repository-native kind/capability/selector check for submit, resume and dispatch.
At dispatch, read current capabilities after asynchronous root/resource preflight immediately before the provider call.
At resume, preserve terminal evidence when authorization fails and condition the update on the inspected state and resume count after the asynchronous configuration read.
Preserve names, schemas, annotations, global admission, root/resource checks, selectors, confirmation and maximum resume count. Already dispatched operations keep existing cancellation behavior.
Update only the two affected descriptions to explain fresh authorization and denied-resume evidence preservation.
Add a Windows manager CI job using the same pinned actions and Node24; test roots remain disposable and no VM/upstream operation is run.

review.independentTriage: Confirmed with high confidence;19 runtime/caller/policy files compared across immutable baseline checkpoints. No dynamic upstream or production execution.
review.freshAgentLimitation: A requested fresh security-boundary agent could not spawn because the agent thread limit was reached. Root independently traced all direct callers and performs a separate challenger pass; the existing independent triage reviewer additionally reviews the patch without relying on pass claims.
review.patchReview: Independent manual static review found no concrete in-scope surviving bypass/regression; code and regression hashes match its frozen snapshot. No test results were supplied to that reviewer.
review.sharedSkillReference: The fix-finding artifact-storage reference was unavailable; repository-backed output follows the session git storage rule.
review.parentChallengerPass: Root separately checked both admin/MCP callers, first and resumed dispatch, every kind/selector, malformed settings, resume state/count CAS, evidence preservation, and legitimate job controls. No remaining in-scope path found. Current permission read occurs after asynchronous preflight; already dispatched work is not retroactively interrupted.
